leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the :hover pseudo-class to change element styles when a user's pointer moves over them
Implement the :focus pseudo-class to style form elements when they receive keyboard or mouse focus
Configure the :active pseudo-class to provide visual feedback during user interaction
Construct CSS rules that combine multiple pseudo-classes for complex interactive states
Manipulate element properties like color, background, and border using pseudo-class selectors
Integrate pseudo-class styles with existing CSS rules to enhance user interface feedback
Initialize interactive components with appropriate pseudo-class styling for accessibility and usability
